title: Replaces the subscription `start` field with `start_date`
summary: Replaces the start field on a subscription resource with a start_date field that represents when the entire subscription starts as opposed to when the current plan configuration does.
migrationNotes: The new start_date field on the subscription resource now represents the original start date of the entire subscription, even if the plan configuration has changed over time. This provides you with a clearer and more comprehensive view of the subscription’s history.
